    Ray presentations of quotients (B5) #

    For split basic data S of B and a two-sided ideal K ⊆ rad B, corners, corner units, rays and insertion spans of B map into those of B / K, and corner elements, units and radical corner elements of B / K lift.

    For a nonzero non-invertible τ of the small ray category P of a distributive B, with representative t, a morphism of P factors through τ iff its representative lies in (t) (repP_mem_idealOf_iff), and the ray table of the residue category P/τ presents B / (t) (isRayPres_res). Hence k(P/τ) is representation-finite when B / (t) is (isRepresentationFinite_res), in every characteristic.
